turns.text: Hi, I was charged for a plan I cancelled. Can you help?
Sorry about that. Could you give me the order number for the charge?
Sure, it's ORD-5101. It was the $64 charge on 1 September.
Thanks for waiting. I'm checking this with the billing team now.
Any update? It's been a couple of days.
Billing has picked it up; they are working through a backlog this week.
Also, my invoice emails keep landing in spam. Can you fix that?
That's a mail-filter setting on your side; adding billing@clouddesk.example to your contacts usually fixes it.
OK, done. Back to the refund though.
Understood. I've added a note to chase billing again.
Can you tell me roughly how long refunds take?
Once approved, refunds reach the card in 5 to 10 business days.
And I'll get an email when it's done?
Yes, an automatic confirmation goes out when the refund is issued.
Also the dashboard was slow yesterday, was there an outage?
There was a short slowdown on the 18th, resolved the same afternoon.
Fine. Still waiting on the refund.
Thanks for your patience, I've escalated the chase internally.
Is there a reference number for this conversation?
Your ticket number is the reference; you don't need anything else.
My colleague asked whether we can change the billing email address.
Yes, any admin can change it under Settings > Billing.
Great. Please just sort the refund.
Will do. I'm handing this to the refunds queue for a final decision.
Thanks. Please confirm once it's done.
I'll update this ticket as soon as there's a decision.
Hello? Following up again.
Apologies for the delay, it's with the refunds desk now.
Ok.
Is there anything else I can help with while you wait?

why: the ticket record has no order id; ORD-5101 exists only in turn 3 of the thread, standard tier, 20 days, inside 30
